title: IFTEX® Clean System G Petrol Additive for All Petrol Cars (400 ml) Treats 400 L Petrol/e 20 Petrol Fuel Treatment and Injector Cleaner for Cleaning deposits & Mileage Improvement (200 ml Pack of 2)
description: IFTEX introduced first time indigenously developed Fuel Additives in India in 1996. System G is designed for Petrol applications, tested and approved in past by major Auto Manufacturers like Ford, General Motors, Tata Motors and Marketed by BPCL and IBP across India through their Petrol Pumps. Used by millions of happy customers since last 30 years earning its reputation as a reliable, proven, and trusted Fuel Additive for Petrol engines. Engines are designed to operate on specific fuels such as Petrol or Diesel. Internationally fuel additives are designed for specific fuel since combustion properties of Petrol and Diesel differ and so their engine designs. Hence additives designed for Petrol engines are not suitable for Diesel engines, and vice versa. Improves fuel economy upto 25% (subject to engine condition, drivability, etc) by regularly using System G as experiences by many customers. Protects against Rust and Corrosion, inlet valve bending and fouling of injectors. System G gives difference in drivability, smoothness, vibration, rough idling, cold starting, hesitation, poor acceleration and noise. E20 is hygroscopic (absorbs water from atmosphere) which can lead to separation of alcohol and petrol having problems like storage, rust and corrosion and valve bending. System G will help in stabilizing the E 20 Fuel and will not affect coupling agent of Petrol and Ethanol. Since Ethanol has lower energy content than Petrol, System G will be required to achieve the same performance level. System G will act as combustion catalyst which will help in rich burning to keep injectors and combustion chamber free from deposit builtup, protect engine from rust and corrosion, protects inlet valve and gives better mileage System G Injector and Complete Fuel System Cleaner will help as Octane Booster for Cars, SUV’s and all petrol vehicles . One bottle of 200 ml will treat upto 200 litres of Petrol. Direction for Use : Remove cap. Squeeze lightly till dispenser fills to 10ml mark.Add before filling up the tank.Use at the rate of 1ml/ltr of petrol. For best results regular use is recommended.
